lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct, high-contrast vertical lines visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively dense on the anterior torso and becomes progressively wider toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Partial bifurcation observed at the dorsal termination point of the 4th and 5th anterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 11th and 12th posterior lines exhibit discontinuities, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast white spots observed on the upper lateral hind limb area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Short, straight dark projections oriented approximately 75 degrees from the frontal plane of the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 1.5 ratio of terminal tip distance to the width of the horn bases.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the orbital regions and two high-contrast white spots on the lateral malar region.
